features.label: No additional span restriction explicitly imposed

operation_bindings.query_signature: Receive arrival i in the fixed order; the algorithm does not submit a numerical query vector.
operation_bindings.response_signature: The full current row a_iᵀ contains n exact input entries. It arrives once and cannot be reread.

comparators.definition: Squared Frobenius residual of the best rank-k approximation A_k

domains.definition: Rows arrive at fixed events i = 1,…,m, each revealing one n-dimensional row. There are no algorithm-selected query vectors.
Return a basis or finite description of a right rank-$k$ subspace, defining a rank-$k$ orthogonal projection $P\in\mathbb R^{n\times n}$. The product $AP$ need not be output.

local_symbols.meaning: The number of identity-block rows in the ST communication reduction.

norms.definition: Euclidean vector norm $\|z\|_2=(\sum_i|z_i|^2)^{1/2}$ and matrix operator norm $\|M\|_{\rm op}=\max_{\|z\|_2=1}\|Mz\|_2$; define $\|M\|_F=(\sum_{ij}|M_{ij}|^2)^{1/2}$.

objects.definition: The matrix $A\in\mathbb R^{m\times n}$ arrives by rows in a public finite encoding. The source hard-instance alphabet $\{0,\pm1,\pm1/\sqrt q\}$ is allowed, with public $q$. The entire input and row order are fixed in advance.

protocols.adversary_information: oblivious fixed input; does not see private seed
protocols.loss_bearing_points: Evaluate the full-matrix projection error only at termination. There is no roundwise online regret.
steps: The input provider fixes the complete matrix A and row order before the private seed is drawn.
Reveal the rows of A sequentially. The algorithm updates its state after reading each row.
Previous input rows are discarded and cannot be requested again.
Final output is an encoding of a rank-$k$ subspace.
